headline: Iran's control of the Strait of Hormuz remains a powerful bargaining chip
context: Despite efforts by U.S. negotiators, Iran says it wants to charge a toll for ships to pass through the Strait of Hormuz. It's yet another unresolved issue of the U.S.-Iran war.

sources.name: NPR
